item.title: Connecticut releases January traffic death data, cites decreased fatalities in 2025
item.description: Traffic fatalities in Connecticut decreased 12% in 2025 compared to the previous year, but pedestrian and bicyclist fatalities increased, with speeding remaining a leading factor in serious crashes.
